operator_rules.check: All Schedule I particulars (a) to (p) are present
Plan is a revolving 3 to 5 year plan (36 to 60 months)
R&D Plan filed within 6 months of the Nigerian Content Plan submission
Approved plan updated every 6 months from the approval date (due dates at approval +6, +12, ... months)
Research scope falls within the Reg 13 areas (advisory: Reg 13 says 'shall include', so an off-list area is a flag for review, not a breach)
Written progress report filed on the first working day of each quarter
Extension requested at least 7 days before the due date, at most once a year
Disapproved plan: revised plan and outstanding obligations within 14 days of notification
Deviation not corrected within 14 days of notification can lead to suspension
Expected outcome is measurable (heuristic stand-in for AI reading: a number or target must appear). Label it as a heuristic on screen.
Budget lines add up to the stated project total
Yearly planned expenditure adds up to the stated plan total

template_rules.check: Project title is 20 words or fewer
Goals and objectives are 800 words or fewer
Start and estimated completion dates stated
A principal investigator is named, with each member's role
Budget covers items a to h
Every major activity has an indicator
Steering team includes NCDMB, the Company and the research center

assumptions_to_confirm: Quarterly reports (R6) are expected from the first quarter-start after the approval date.
R4 uses a fixed schedule from the approval date. Reg 12 could also be read as 'at least every six months'.
The Template's 14-day approval target is the Board's response time, not the operator's correction window. Keep them separate on screen.
Expatriate-quota and procurement rules are left out: their thresholds were not checked against the Act's text.
